name: CalendarLeafEventCard
job: An event card whose date is a wall-calendar leaf; a tap tears the leaf and turns it into an add-to-calendar download, so visitors save the event instead of forgetting it
visitor_action: tap the leaf or press Enter to add the event to the calendar; the card itself links to details
owner_settings: Start and end date and time
mobile: leaf sits top-left over the photo, 112px tap target; card stacks photo over details, side by side from 700px
motion: leaf tears and curls away along an eased arc, tick draws in on the page beneath; leaf flutters twice when first seen (reduced-motion: leaf swaps to the tick, no flutter)

checks.render: pass (1 fix: clamp long add-to-calendar label on the leaf to 2 lines)

provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Wall calendar: warm white card, tomato-red leaf header, charcoal numerals, kraft backing strip, soft paper shadow
notes: Add to calendar downloads an .ics file (floating local time, no time zone); no Google Calendar link. The leaf stays torn until reload.
